accionanimal.desc: Appointment booking platform for Acción Animal's spay/neuter and vaccination campaigns. It includes the public site to book, search, reschedule and cancel appointments; an admin panel for campaigns, patients, no-shows and users; and an API with Mercado Pago or bank transfer payments and automatic email reminders with retries and auditing.
